== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Plasma pistols are handheld energy weapons that vary significantly in design, power, and functionality. While many standard models fail to operate in a vacuum or corrosive environments without specific modifications, certain specialized versions like the [[Lightcaster IV]] are capable of functioning in space. These weapons can range from high-grade [[Aethertech]] handheld cannons characterized by flickering, razor-edged energy to more conventional models that fire superheated globes of [[plasma]]. Some advanced iterations, such as the [[Zenith Cannon]], may appear to be standard pistols but possess unique internal mechanisms and can fire tightly clustered orange bolts. Other specialized variants, like the [[Lightcaster Heavy II]] or the [[VC-U6 Rainbringer]], are designed for specific users like soldiers in powered armor or incorporate multi-shot bursts that combine [[plasma]] with magically accelerated projectiles. The effects of these weapons vary from exploding against shields to delivering concentrated beams of light infused with specific magical properties.}}
